# Nodivara

> Nodivara is an open-source server control panel, aimed at the same job as aaPanel and cPanel, with a built-in AI agent that proposes changes and waits for human approval. It is written in Rust with a Svelte interface, targets Linux servers and a desktop app, and is pre-alpha: nothing is installable yet.

Status: pre-alpha, as of 2026-11-20. There is no release and nothing is installable yet. What runs today, from source: a read-only Linux inventory (ports, processes, cron, PM2, systemd, Docker) and a parity check of two inventories with seven rules, usable as a server migration checklist. Libraries for the AI assistant, secret storage, migration plans and transports exist but nothing runs them end to end, and no approval or execution path exists. Everything else described as planned is not available. Provisional license: AGPL-3.0-only. Facts about other products are dated and sourced in the comparison page. Documents exist in English and Indonesian (`*.id.md`).
